\begin{example} \end{example}[The Figure-Eight Curve]

1. ch4:4.19The map $\beta :(-\pi ,\pi )\to \mathbb R^2$ given by \[ \beta (t)=(\sin 2t,\sin t) \] is an injective smooth immersion but not a topological embedding.

\sketch Its derivative $(2\cos 2t,\cos t)$ never vanishes, while its image is compact and its domain is not. \end{example}
